name: Zümrüt Boran
bio_fr:
Zümrüt Boran graduated from the Department of Plastic Arts at Yeditepe University’s Faculty of Fine Arts, studying under Ergin İnan, Zahit Büyükişleyen and Özdemir Altan. She has worked in Istanbul for about twenty years.

Moving between figurative and abstract expressionism, her layered, colourful paintings explore the tension between the inner self and the identity projected outward.

Her recent work centres on two series. Silent Clown examines vulnerability, suppressed emotions and the pressure to be visible; the red nose symbolises an expression imposed from outside. XOX – Let’s Play turns a childhood game into a metaphor for life’s recurring choices, encounters and new beginnings.

Together, they reveal an inner energy that persists despite adversity and a determination to preserve the joy of living.

She has exhibited in solo and group shows and art fairs in Istanbul, Izmir, Adana and Antalya.
